text:
Jordan (cust-support): Hey team, cust-824 reports embeddings shape changed after we applied a pinned variant update this morning. They were expecting 1536 but getting 1024.
Alyssa (eng): ugh. Do we have a request+response sample? model id + variant + any pin metadata?
Jordan (cust-support): Sending curl and response snippet from their app: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-small","input":["hello"]}'
```
Response: 
```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.001, ...],"length":1024}],"model":"redwood-embed-small:v3-quant"}
```
Jordan (cust-support): They say before pinning they got length:1536 for same client. Pin was to variant v3-quant ~ 03:12 UTC.
Devon (infra): @Alyssa can you check rollout logs for that pinned swap? Might've swapped to a smaller embedding head (quantized) variant.
Alyssa (eng): On it. Quick triage: if a variant has a different output dim we should have rejected the pin, but there are edgecases for legacy pinned manifests. Can you also paste the exact model string they used in server logs?
Jordan (cust-support): From app logs: `redwood-embed-small:2026-03-15-pin-774 -> redwood-embed-small:v3-quant`
Mike (sre): Two action items: 1) roll back the customer's pin to the previous variant if they need immediate stability, 2) capture a minimal repro (curl with w/ accept header) and we can run against both variants.
rollout-bot: [deployment] pinned-variant-update redwood-embed-small:v3-quant applied by @ops at 2026-03-15T03:12:08Z (id: pin-774)
Alyssa (eng): I pulled the model manifests: v3-quant uses a compressed head with 1024 output dims. The previous default variant was 'v2-full' with 1536 dims. Hmm — pin validation logic should have flagged mismatch. Filing infra ticket.
Devon (infra): Possible root cause: our pin-swap path didn't compare `embedding_dim` in the manifest when the pin came from the legacy UI. That explains why it allowed the variant swap.
Jordan (cust-support): Customer wants either rollback or a compatibility shim. They have a cosine-based index expecting 1536 dims.
Alyssa (eng): Short term: suggest rollback to v2-full for that customer. I'll open a hotfix to reject pins that change embedding_dim for models that have existing pinned materialized indices.
Mike (sre): I can rollback pin-774 for cust-824. Do we have approval? Jordan pls confirm customer ok with rollback.
Jordan (cust-support): Confirmed with customer: rollback is fine, they'd prefer rollback + postmortem. :thumbsup:
Alyssa (eng): Thanks. After rollback we'll add a server-side guard and emit a warning in the API response if the requested model variant changes vector length. Also add an audit event for any future pin attempts.
Devon (infra): Repro notes for internal: run embedding request against both variants: 
```bash
# v3-quant
curl -X POST ... -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-small:v3-quant","input":["x"]}'
# v2-full
curl -X POST ... -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-small:v2-full","input":["x"]}'
```
Alyssa (eng): I'll attach the manifest diff in the ticket. Also check batching path: if batchpad or concat is mixing variants we may see downstream shape issues too (but here it's variant-level).
Jordan (cust-support): Customer notes their batch size was 8, single-threaded client. They saw immediate failures in downstream index (shape mismatch errors).
Mike (sre): Rollback scheduled in 5m. Post-rollback, verify via sample curl and confirm index ingestion resumes.
Jordan (cust-support): Will update customer after rollback and collect logs for postmortem. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
